The '''Ertrax system''' was located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="TEA" /> and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ertrax]], which was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Ertraxi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. At some point, a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crash-landed on Ertrax with no survivors. The Ertraxi found the wrecked vessel and eventually repaired it flew it off-world in order to search out and contact other species.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

{{RPGseed}}
Shortly after that, a group of [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] [[Star map/Legends|charting]] the far reaches of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] found a trail of [[Cronau radiation/Legends|Cronau radiation]] left behind by the starship and followed it, leading them to discover Ertrax and make first contact with the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]. When the group brought news of its discovery back to the wider [[galactic community]], the explorers learned that the information spurred many opportunistic [[Merchant/Legends|traders]], [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], and would-be conquerors to travel to the Ertrax [[Star system/Legends|system]] in order to exploit the newly-found planet.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Essential_Atlas.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Ertrax system was first mentioned in ''The Essential Atlas''.]]
The Ertrax system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. The book was authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], and it placed the system in grid square N-21.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[2008]] sourcebook [[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']], published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', described Ertrax in a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure seed that suggested two possible courses of action for the player characters regarding their discovery of the planet: The characters can either keep the reward offered for the information on the newfound world, or they can forfeit the fee by returning to the Ertrax system and helping the Ertraxi protect themselves against the threat of exploitation, either by warning and arming the natives or by assisting them with gaining a Republic membership.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
